messages.message: Hi, I need help with transaction coordination

Hello John! I'd be happy to help you with transaction coordination. I offer two plans:

💼 Base Plan: $350 per transaction
• Contract timeline tracking
• Digital calendar & milestone alerts
• Document assistance

🌟 Pro Plan: $450 per transaction
• Everything in Base Plan
• Weekly stakeholder reports
• Client care services

Which plan interests you most?
Tell me more about the Pro Plan

Great choice! The Pro Plan is our most popular option. Here's what makes it special:

🌟 Pro Plan Features ($450):
• Everything in Base Plan
• Weekly cadence reports (Mon-Thu structured updates)
• Client care with personalized welcome letters
• Weekly buyer/seller status updates
• Utility request assistance
• Closing day preparation support

Most agents find the Pro Plan worth every penny for the client care alone! It keeps your clients informed and happy throughout the process.

Would you like to get started with our New Partner Special?
Do you offer mobile notary services?

Absolutely! I come to you for your convenience:

🚗 Mobile Service Locations:
• Your home
• Your office
• Hospitals and care facilities
• Coffee shops or libraries
• Any safe, quiet location

📅 Flexible Scheduling:
• Same-day appointments often available
• Evening and weekend appointments
• Emergency notarization services

💰 Travel is included in my service fee for most local areas

Ready to schedule? Call me at 954-872-8141!
